title: Debugger Evaluator: can enter expression to evaluate during manual pause but will error due to empty stack
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 63.75 GiB memory ### Issue description When pausing the game manually via top-right button Pause Running Project (F7), it **is** possible to enter an expression in the Debugger > Evaluator panel, but it won't display anything: and cause an error: ``` E 0:00:20:143 debug_get_stack_level_instance: Index p_level = -1 is out of bounds ((int)_call_stack_size = 0). modules/gdscript/gdscript_editor.cpp:382 @ debug_get_stack_level_instance() ``` Clearly the code expects some callstack, but there is none. I thought it was related to having a "static context" as in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/107785 where Evaluator fails in static functions, but the error is different. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Run game 2. Pause game manually via top-right button Pause Running Project (F7) 3. Enter Debugger > Evaluator 4. Enter expression `true` and press Enter (or click Evaluate) => the expression is not added to history 5. Check the Errors panel => error above ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
